import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create an in-memory DataFrame
df_original = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "salary": [50000.0, 60000.0, 70000.0],
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df_original)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = BytesIO()
df_original.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the binary data
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nParquet binary size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from binary to create a new DataFrame
buffer_read = BytesIO(parquet_bytes)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer_read)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
print("\nDataFrames equal:", df_original.equals(df_restored))

```python
import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create an in-memory DataFrame
df_original = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "salary": [50000.0, 60000.0, 70000.0],
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df_original)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory using BytesIO
buffer = BytesIO()
df_original.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the binary data
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nParquet binary size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from binary to create a new DataFrame
buffer_read = BytesIO(parquet_bytes)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer_read)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
print("\nDataFrames equal:", df_original.equals(df_restored))
```
